title: Member portal and application – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: Membership and your club data
hero.lead: Apply for membership, review linked member records and submit traceable changes.

body:
Apply for membership

If no accessible membership exists, navigation shows Become a member. Choose the club, read its statutes and open the application. Membership starts only after approval.

  1. Check club and statute version.
  2. Enter the requested personal and membership data.
  3. Add only requested evidence.
  4. Review and submit.
  5. Follow status, questions and replies on the application.

Use the member portal

After a confirmed link, Member portal appears. If several relationships exist, select the correct person and club first. The overview separates profile, finances, documents and change requests.

Submit and correct changes

Open Changes, compare the current state and change only outdated information. Submitted requests keep their status and history. Where allowed, withdraw, correct and resubmit a request. Questions from club management and your replies remain in the history.

Finances, documents and links

Finances shows released receivables, payments and mandate data for this relationship. Documents provides final documents for download. An account, player or coach link does not itself create membership. If an existing membership is missing, request the link from the profile or contact club management.
